title: Broadcast Catalog Enrichment
description:
NovaMart’s clickstream job attaches product attributes to every event before BI aggregates the day. Events land in one Parquet drop; the product catalog lands in another.

The catalog is versioned. The same `product_id` can appear many times, each with a different `effective_ts`. Downstream wants the **current** row for that product, not every version that ever existed.

Read events from `INPUT_A_PATH` and the catalog from `INPUT_B_PATH`. For each event, attach the current catalog attributes for its `product_id` and write Parquet to `OUTPUT_PATH`.

**Current** means:

- the catalog row with the latest `effective_ts` for that `product_id`
- if two rows share that timestamp, keep the one with the smaller `product_name`

Events whose `product_id` has no catalog match are out of scope — drop them. The catalog also carries a `payload` used by other pipelines; do not include it in the output. Extra event columns (`quantity`, `session_id`, `visitor_id`, `channel`, `country_code`) stay on the event file and are not required in the output.

The driver is 512 MB. That is enough for a real current dimension, and not enough for years of SCD history treated as if it were one.

**Run** uses 20,000 events and a current-only catalog (2,000 products, one version). **Submit** uses 1 million events and the 2 million-row versioned catalog from the NovaMart playground cluster.

## Events (`INPUT_A_PATH`)

| Column | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event_id` | BIGINT | Grade key |
| `product_id` | INT | Join key |
| `event_type` | STRING | `view`, `click`, `purchase`, `refund` |
| `amount` | DECIMAL(10,2) | Event amount |
| `quantity` | INT | Units (0 on view/click) |
| `session_id` | STRING | Session |
| `visitor_id` | STRING | Visitor |
| `channel` | STRING | `web`, `ios`, `android` |
| `country_code` | STRING | ISO country |

## Catalog (`INPUT_B_PATH`)

| Column | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `product_id` | INT | Join key |
| `product_name` | STRING | Name at this version |
| `category` | STRING | Category at this version |
| `brand` | STRING | Brand (stable per product) |
| `list_price` | DECIMAL(10,2) | List price at this version |
| `effective_ts` | DATE | When this version became effective |
| `payload` | BINARY | Other pipelines; **do not emit** |

## Example

Catalog for `product_id = 17` (history is scrambled on disk; do not use “last file row”):

| product_id | product_name | category | brand | list_price | effective_ts | payload |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 17 | sku-00000017-v000 | Home | Acme | 12.00 | 2020-01-01 | *(blob)* |
| 17 | sku-00000017-v001 | Kitchen | Acme | 14.00 | 2020-01-08 | *(blob)* |
| 17 | sku-00000017-v002 | Kitchen | Acme | 15.00 | 2020-01-15 | *(blob)* |
| 17 | sku-00000017-alt | Kitchen | Acme | 15.00 | 2020-01-15 | *(blob)* |

Current for 17 is **`sku-00000017-alt`**: latest date is 2020-01-15, and `…-alt` sorts before `…-v002`.

Events:

| event_id | product_id | event_type | amount | quantity | … |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 17 | purchase | 15.00 | 1 | … |
| 2 | 17 | view | 0.00 | 0 | … |
| 3 | 99 | click | 0.00 | 0 | … |

`99` has no catalog row → drop. Output:

| event_id | product_id | event_type | amount | product_name | category | brand | list_price | effective_ts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 17 | purchase | 15.00 | sku-00000017-alt | Kitchen | Acme | 15.00 | 2020-01-15 |
| 2 | 17 | view | 0.00 | sku-00000017-alt | Kitchen | Acme | 15.00 | 2020-01-15 |

One output row per matched `event_id`. Joining the full history would emit four rows for event 1. Snapshot to one row per product first, then join.

**Note: join only the current catalog row per product. Joining the full versioned history duplicates every event; broadcasting that history will not fit in the driver heap.**

data.overview: NovaMart attaches current product attributes to clickstream events before BI aggregates the day. Two Parquet drops: 1 million events (~22.1 MB) and a versioned product catalog of 2,000,400 rows (~28.1 MB on disk) with brand, list_price, and a 120-byte payload. For each event, join the current catalog row — latest effective_ts, tie-break smaller product_name — and drop unmatched events. Run uses 20,000 events and a 2,000-row current snapshot; Submit uses the full drops.

datasets.name: Events
datasets.distribution: 1 million clickstream rows with session, visitor, channel, and country. About 4% of product_ids have no catalog match and must be dropped. event_type is one of view, click, purchase, refund. quantity is 0 on view/click.

datasets.name: Product catalog (SCD)
datasets.distribution: 40,000 products × 50 weekly versions, plus ~1% name ties at the latest effective_ts (keep the smaller product_name). Brand is stable per product; list_price can change by version. Each row carries a 120-byte payload used by other pipelines — do not emit it. ~28.1 MB on disk; the uncompressed history will not fit a 512 MB driver. A current-row snapshot is 40,000 rows and is safe to broadcast.

expectedOutput.description: effective_ts of the current catalog row

problemStatement.moat:
Setter notes — not shown to learners.

## What was in mind

“Broadcast the dimension” is usually right, but only after the dimension is the **rows you actually need**. NovaMart’s catalog on disk is SCD history, not a current dim. The lab exists so someone who types `broadcast(catalog)` on the full drop hits a driver OOM, and someone who joins history without a snapshot explodes `event_id`.

The question we wanted History to answer on a failed Submit: **did you broadcast history, or the current dimension?**

## How we created it

1. **False-friend Run** — 20k events + `catalog_current` (2k products, one version). Naive broadcast looks correct and fast.
2. **Submit** — 1M events + `catalog_scd` (40k × 50 versions + ~1% name ties + 120-byte `payload`). Same starter code.
3. **Driver 512m** — enough for a real current snapshot (~40k rows), not enough to collect uncompressed history on the driver. On-disk ~28 MB is Snappy; payload alone is ~230 MB in memory.
4. **Grade `event_id`** — one output row per matched event. History join fails even if memory holds.
5. **`payload` is ballast** — other pipelines need it; this job must not emit it. `brand` / `list_price` make enrichment look like a dim attach. Extra event columns (`session_id`, `channel`, …) make the fact look like clickstream without changing the join.
6. **No `event_ts`** — “current” is latest `effective_ts` per product (tie-break smaller `product_name`). As-of at event time is a different lab.

Intended shape: window to current → drop payload → join (broadcast of the snapshot is optional).

## What this is not

- Not Interchange Fee (skew, salting, 100M facts).
- Wall-clock is not the score. The correct plan is supposed to finish quickly.
- Auto-broadcast will not fire (file size > 10 MB threshold). The trap is the explicit `broadcast` hint on history.

gradeChecks: Spark job succeeds on the shared 1M events + versioned catalog
OUTPUT_PATH is Parquet with one row per matched event
Current catalog row only (latest effective_ts, tie-break product_name); brand and list_price attached; payload is not in the output
